creature_portraits.doc: Creature portraits in the bestiary (M2-MNU-302, ADR 0120; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Bestiary). The PNGs are baked by tools/portraits/render.sh from tools/portraits/portraits.json 'creatures' (one per creatures.json row); CreaturePortraits finds an enemy's picture through its enemies.json `model` (the creature actor scene) and that scene's creatures.json id: <dir><file_fmt with {creature}>. An enemy without a model, or whose creature has no PNG, has no portrait (the page shows no frame). 'silhouette_unread': a foe defeated but never Read shows its picture as a silhouette (modulated to the theme colour 'frame.silhouette_role'), as its page shows only its name. 'frame': CreaturePortraitFrame's panel variation, the inset (reference px) between frame and picture, and the soft pool of light behind the creature (theme colour 'glow_role' at the centre, fading to clear at 'glow_radius' of the frame, 0..0.5). 'people' (Act I final pass, ADR 0041): an enemy who is a person, not a creature, shows that character's menu portrait (HeroPortraits, its neutral picture).
